contexts.summaryId: Kabut asap lintas batas sedang hingga pekat dilaporkan di sebagian Semenanjung Malaysia, Kalimantan, Sumatra dan Sarawak selatan. Kabut juga diamati di bagian Papua, Maluku dan Sulawesi.
contexts.summaryEn: Moderate to dense transboundary smoke haze was reported over parts of Peninsular Malaysia, Kalimantan, Sumatra and southern Sarawak. Haze was also observed over parts of Papua, Maluku and Sulawesi.

contexts.title: Haze situation update
contexts.summaryId: Kabut asap dari Kalimantan dan Sumatra teramati di kawasan sekitar Singapura. Sebagian berada di lapisan lebih tinggi, dengan pencampuran terbatas ke permukaan.
contexts.summaryEn: Smoke haze from Kalimantan and Sumatra was observed over the surrounding region. Some haze was at higher altitudes above Singapore, with limited mixing to surface levels.
